# Questions & answers

Write a question, set its answer key, preview it as a participant, and run the quiz.

[QuestionView](#questionview) · [AnswerInput](#answerinput) · [QuestionComposer](#questioncomposer) · [AnswerOptionsEditor](#answeroptionseditor) · [AnswerKeyEditor](#answerkeyeditor) · [QuestionPreview](#questionpreview) · [QuestionBank](#questionbank) · [QuizRunner](#quizrunner)

### QuestionView

One question as the participant sees it: type, points and timer, prompt, pictures, hint, the answer input, then the result banner.

```ts
import { QuestionView } from '@/contest/components/QuestionView'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question to show. |
| `value` *(required)* | `AnswerValue \| null` |  | The answer typed so far. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: AnswerValue) => void` |  | Called on every change of the answer. |
| `state` | `'open' \| 'answered' \| 'correct' \| 'wrong' \| 'timeout' \| 'locked'` | `'open'` | Open and answered can be edited; the others lock the input and show a banner. |
| `answerKey` | `AnswerKey \| null` |  | Shows what was right once the question is locked. Pass it only after the answer is final. |
| `earned` | `number` |  | Points earned, shown in the banner of a finished question. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up a media file by id, to show pictures and sounds. Without it, attachments are left out. |
| `upload` | `UploadHandler` |  | Sends a file for an upload question. Without it the upload box stays switched off. |
| `secondsLeft` | `number` |  | Seconds left. Shows a timer; it turns red under 10 seconds. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QuestionView
  question={question}
  value={answer}
  onChange={setAnswer}
  state={locked ? 'correct' : 'open'}
  answerKey={locked ? key : undefined}
  earned={locked ? 10 : undefined}
/>
```

- It never reads or sends data. The same component shows the real quiz and the preview in the editor, so they cannot drift apart.
- The hint is hidden once the question is finished.

### AnswerInput

The right answer input for any question type. ChoiceAnswer, TextAnswer, NumericAnswer, OrderingAnswer, MatchingAnswer and UploadAnswer are the six inputs it picks from.

```ts
import { AnswerInput } from '@/contest/components/Answers'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question to answer. |
| `value` *(required)* | `AnswerValue \| null` |  | The current answer. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: AnswerValue) => void` |  | Called with the new answer. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Locks the input. |
| `reveal` | `AnswerKey \| null` |  | After the answer is locked: marks right and wrong parts and shows the right answer. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up a media file by id, to show pictures and sounds. Without it, attachments are left out. |
| `upload` | `UploadHandler` |  | Sends a file for an upload question. Without it the upload box stays switched off. |

```tsx
<AnswerInput question={question} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
{/* Or pick the input yourself: */}
<ChoiceAnswer question={choiceQuestion} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
```

- Choice questions use native radio buttons and checkboxes, so the keyboard works. Ordering lists are reordered with the handle, or with Space and the arrow keys.
- Number answers keep what the person typed ("3." stays "3.") while the answer holds the parsed number. A comma works as a decimal mark.
- An ordering question starts shuffled (the same way every time for the same question).

### QuestionComposer

The form for one question: type, prompt, media, options, points, time limit, tags, hint and explanation. It saves nothing; it hands every change to `onChange`.

```ts
import { QuestionComposer } from '@/contest/components/QuestionComposer'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question being edited. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Called with the whole updated question. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up attached media to show thumbnails. |
| `onPickMedia` | `(target: { kind: 'prompt' } \| { kind: 'option'; id: string }) => void` |  | Open your media picker for the chosen target, then call `onChange` with the result. Leave out to hide the buttons. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QuestionComposer
  question={draft}
  onChange={setDraft}
  media={lookup}
  onPickMedia={(target) => setPicking(target)}
/>
```

- Changing the type keeps the prompt, points, tags and media and builds the fields the new type needs (see `convertQuestion`).
- The answer key is a separate editor, `AnswerKeyEditor`, because the key is back-office only.

### AnswerOptionsEditor

Add, remove, reorder and rename the options of a question. Each option can have a picture and a note shown after answering.

```ts
import { AnswerOptionsEditor } from '@/contest/components/AnswerOptionsEditor'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` *(required)* | `ChoiceOption[]` |  | The options. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(options: ChoiceOption[]) => void` |  | Called with the new list. |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` |  | Names the list for screen readers, for example "Answer options". |
| `idPrefix` | `string` | `'o'` | Prefix for new option ids, so ids stay unique per list. |
| `min` | `number` | `2` | Fewest options. Remove buttons switch off at this count. |
| `max` | `number` | `8` | Most options. The add button switches off at this count. |
| `onPickMedia` | `(optionId: string) => void` |  | Shows a picture button on each row and calls this to attach one. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up pictures for the thumbnails. |
| `feedback` | `boolean` |  | Adds a note field to each option. |
| `addLabel` | `string` | `'Add option'` | Text of the add button. |

```tsx
<AnswerOptionsEditor label="Answer options" options={q.options} onChange={(options) => setQ({ ...q, options })} feedback />
```

- Built on the kit `SortableList`, so rows can be dragged or moved with the keyboard.

### AnswerKeyEditor

The back-office editor for the answer key: right options, accepted wordings, number and tolerance, right order, matching pairs, or a rubric. It warns when the key no longer fits and has a "Try an answer" box.

```ts
import { AnswerKeyEditor } from '@/contest/components/AnswerKeyEditor'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question the key belongs to. |
| `value` *(required)* | `AnswerKey \| null` |  | The key being edited, or null when there is none yet. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(key: AnswerKey) => void` |  | Called with the new key. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up pictures for the "Try an answer" box. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<AnswerKeyEditor question={question} value={key} onChange={saveKey} />
```

- "Try an answer" scores a sample answer with the same `scoreAnswer` that scores real submissions, and shows why it got those points. Nothing is saved.
- A text key can accept several wordings, each with its own share of the points, and ignore capitals, accents and punctuation.

### QuestionPreview

The question exactly as a participant sees it, on a phone, tablet or desktop frame, with a state scrubber: open, answered, right, wrong, time up, locked.

```ts
import { QuestionPreview } from '@/contest/components/QuestionPreview'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` *(required)* | `Question` |  | The question to preview. |
| `answerKey` | `AnswerKey \| null` |  | Used to fill in the right and wrong answers of the scrubber states. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up attached media. |
| `initialState` | `'open' \| 'answered' \| 'correct' \| 'wrong' \| 'timeout' \| 'locked'` | `'open'` | The state shown first. |
| `device` | `'phone' \| 'tablet' \| 'desktop'` | `'phone'` | The device frame shown first. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SplitPane
  start={<QuestionComposer question={q} onChange={setQ} />}
  end={<QuestionPreview question={q} answerKey={key} />}
/>
```

- Pair it with `QuestionComposer` in a `SplitPane`: the preview updates as you type.
- You can answer in the "Open" state; the preview then switches to "Answered".

### QuestionBank

All questions in a searchable, sortable, filterable table: type, points, time, status, whether the answer key is complete, and tags.

```ts
import { QuestionBank } from '@/contest/components/QuestionBank'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The questions. |
| `keys` | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | The answer keys by question id, to show which questions still need one. |
| `selectedId` | `string \| null` |  | The question open in the editor; its title is highlighted. |
| `onSelect` *(required)* | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called when a question title is clicked. |
| `onAdd` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "New question" button. |
| `onDuplicate` | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Shows a duplicate button on each row. |
| `onDelete` | `(question: Question) => void` |  | Shows a delete button on each row. Ask for confirmation in your handler. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<QuestionBank questions={questions} keys={keys} selectedId={openId} onSelect={setOpenId} onAdd={addQuestion} />
```

- It is the kit `DataGrid`, so column sorting, resizing, density and column visibility come with it. The layout is remembered in this browser.

### QuizRunner

The participant's whole quiz: one question at a time, a question map, per-question timers, a save indicator, an overview before submitting, and the result afterwards.

```ts
import { QuizRunner } from '@/contest/components/QuizRunner'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `questions` *(required)* | `Question[]` |  | The questions in play order. |
| `answers` | `Answer[]` |  | The answers saved so far. Read once, when the runner mounts; give it a new `key` to start over. |
| `onAnswer` *(required)* | `(answer: Answer) => void` |  | Called a moment after the person stops changing an answer, and when they leave the question. |
| `onSubmit` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the person confirms the submit dialog. |
| `status` | `'in-progress' \| 'submitted' \| 'reviewed'` | `'in-progress'` | Anything but in-progress locks every question and shows the result. |
| `scores` | `Record<string, Score>` |  | Points per question, shown after submitting. |
| `answerKeys` | `Record<string, AnswerKey>` |  | Answer keys. Pass them only after submitting: they reveal the right answers. |
| `media` | `(id: string) => MediaAsset \| undefined` |  | Looks up attached media. |
| `upload` | `UploadHandler` |  | Sends a file for an upload question. Without it the upload box stays switched off. |
| `title` | `string` | `'Quiz'` | Heading of the quiz. |
| `saveDelay` | `number` | `700` | Milliseconds to wait after the last change before `onAnswer`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
const { data: submission, saveAnswer, submit } = useMySubmission(me.id)

<QuizRunner
  key={me.id}
  questions={questions}
  answers={submission.answers}
  status={submission.status}
  scores={submission.scores}
  onAnswer={saveAnswer}
  onSubmit={submit}
/>
```

- A question with a time limit counts down while it is on screen. When time runs out the answer is saved and locked.
- It keeps its own copy of the answers so typing never waits for the network. Leaving the page saves what is waiting.
- Wrap it in `ContestProvider` only if you use the data hooks; the runner itself takes props only.
